transmission: No peer communication performed. Objects retained for coordinator use.

objects.parameter: odd n=2m+1 >= 3; explicitly listed variables x_1,...,x_n
objects.input_accounting: Each coefficient has O(log n) bits, largest magnitude O(n^4); full indexed description Theta(n^2 log n). No auxiliary variables.
objects.exact_failed_claim: There is a choice of coordinate branching and node order such that every signed-integer QUBO has a polynomial-size proof tree, when node pruning uses the first Boolean moment SDP strengthened by every valid two-variable marginal inequality and integer ceiling of the lower bound, even with the true optimum supplied as incumbent.
objects.counter_statement: Every such tree for E_n has at least 2*binomial(2m-1,m) frontier nodes, hence Theta(2^n/sqrt(n)) nodes are mandatory.
objects.precise_pruning_scope: Partial assignments only; branch on an individual free bit. The optimal candidate is supplied as a feasible incumbent, without optimality being accepted as a proved premise. Leaves may be certified by the specified relaxation lower bound reaching the incumbent, or by a complete assignment. No arbitrary additional cuts, aggregate branching, preprocessing certificates, memoized proof-DAG sharing, or other terminal rules are included.
objects.scope: Restricted proof-tree lower bound. It is not a lower bound for all algorithms, all SDP methods, all branch-and-bound systems, or unrestricted exact QUBO.

objects.exact_failed_claim: Every nonnegative quadratic on the Boolean cube is a finite nonnegative linear combination of unconditional generators consisting of squares of affine forms, products ell*(ell-1) for integer-coefficient affine forms ell, and nonnegative functions of at most two bits, modulo Boolean identities.
objects.counter_statement: F admits no such finite conic combination, even without any bound on term count or coefficient magnitude.
objects.scope: Only this unconditional degree-two generator cone. Conditional multipliers, case splits, auxiliary extensions, other certificate languages, and unrestricted optimisation algorithms are outside the claim.
objects.source: Grishukhin Gr7 inequality as printed in Avis and Ito, arXiv:math/0505143, converted using delta_ij=x_i+x_j-2*x_i*x_j and x7=0; F is minus half the printed left side.
